segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Thanks for calling support, this is Maya. How can I help today?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Hi Maya, yeah, this is Colin at Redbrook Analytics. We need to add 12 user seats to our account before our training on May 14.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Sure, I can help with that. Can I confirm your account domain is redbrookanalytics.com?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yep, that's right. We're currently at 48 seats, I think, and we need to go to 60.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: I’m checking the admin console now. Yeah, I see 48 active seats on the Business plan, billed annually through February 28, 2027. Do you want the 12 added under the same billing terms?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yes, same terms. If there’s a prorated charge, that’s fine. The PO is RB-4117.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Got it. I’m adding the seats now and attaching PO RB-4117 in the billing tool. The prorated amount for the 12 seats is $3,240. It’ll appear on invoice 78241, due June 1.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay, perfect. Will our admin be able to invite people right away?

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Yes. The seat count is updated to 60 now. Your admin, Dana Mills, can send invites immediately from the Users page.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Great, that’s all I needed. Thanks for making it quick.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: No problem. I also added a note to ticket 146928 with the seat change and invoice details. Have a good one.
